shared.source_boundary_body: This is a non-normative discovery view generated from canonical repository facts. It does not change maturity, create a runtime package, or establish production adoption.
shared.footer_line: Reference surfaces for consequential product work.

page.title: Find a component by task and evidence.
page.lead: Browse stable KIN components by catalog tier, then open a bounded Explorer when a deep reference is available.
page.stable_intro: Names, tiers, maturity, support, references, tests, and gaps are read from the canonical Component catalog at build time.
page.other_intro: These records remain discoverable but are not presented as complete components and do not receive deep Explorer routes.

explorer.reference_intro: The frame opens one supported reference state. Use the separate link when the embedded reference is too narrow or unavailable.
explorer.reference_language_mismatch: This canonical fixture is currently Chinese-only; the surrounding English Explorer does not imply an English runtime reference.
explorer.states_boundary: The runnable frame shows only the inspected state above. A generated applicable-state inventory is deferred until canonical machine-readable state sources exist; the core and component-specific contracts remain authoritative.
explorer.no_known_gaps: No gap is recorded for this component in the canonical catalog.
explorer.accessibility_boundary_body: The reference exposes catalog support and automated checks. Named manual checks remain explicit and do not establish assistive-technology or adopting-product completion.

button.job: Execute one discrete action with clear hierarchy, stable geometry, and visible progress or recovery.
button.boundary: The reference demonstrates deterministic appearance and local states. Requests, permissions, committed results, and undo remain product-owned.
button.state_label: Action hierarchy, async feedback, menus, and recovery

app-shell.job: Keep navigation, the current workspace, contextual properties, and command surfaces in a stable relationship.
app-shell.boundary: The reference demonstrates deterministic shell structure. Product routes, permissions, data, and adoption evidence remain product-owned.

evidence-list.job: Map a claim or decision to supporting, missing, stale, or conflicting sources without collapsing them into one score.
evidence-list.boundary: The sources are deterministic fixture content. They do not establish live provenance or authoritative verification.

suggested-change-review.job: Compare current and proposed values before a person accepts, rejects, or edits a change.
suggested-change-review.boundary: The review is local and reversible inside the reference. It does not persist a product change or grant approval authority.

execution-preview.job: Expose targets, writes, external effects, permissions, irreversibility, and rollback before execution.
execution-preview.boundary: The reference creates no external side effect. Authorization, scope validation, execution, and rollback remain product-owned.

background-task-queue.job: Keep accepted long-running work identifiable through progress, cancellation, failure, recovery, and result access.
background-task-queue.boundary: The queue uses deterministic local tasks. It does not prove backend persistence, idempotency, cancellation, or retry.
background-task-queue.state_label: Mixed running, failed, and completed tasks

command-menu.job: Launch navigation and actions from an immediately usable, keyboard-first searchable surface.
command-menu.boundary: The reference demonstrates invocation, filtering, focus, and return behavior over fixture commands, not a product-wide search service.

authentication-dialog.job: Restore one blocked action through a modal sign-in task while preserving the underlying workflow.
authentication-dialog.boundary: The dialog is an interface reference only. It does not authenticate, manage credentials, enforce sessions, or authorize the resumed action.

data-table.job: Compare related records through named columns, stable row semantics, selection, and keyboard-accessible actions.
data-table.boundary: The fixture is bounded. Real datasets, virtualization, authorization, responsive priority, and assistive-technology evidence remain product responsibilities.

page.title: Four layouts, shaped by the work.
page.lead: Reading, investigation, operations, and precision editing need different compositions. KIN keeps orientation and recovery intact across all four.
page.reference_language_mismatch: This canonical fixture is currently Chinese-only; the English Pattern record remains a discovery layer rather than an English runtime reference.
page.maturity_note: Pattern documents have no independent machine maturity. The status shown here belongs only to the joined Page record.

information-site.label: Information Site
information-site.summary: Search, subject identity, reading order, provenance, revision, and stable location lead before explanation.
prohibited_substitutions: A marketing Hero before search, the subject, or reading content
Equal cards replacing records, citations, or reading order
An unsourced generated summary replacing provenance

intelligence-workspace.label: Intelligence Workspace
intelligence-workspace.summary: Entity identity, evidence, history, and reversible review stay visible while list selection changes.
prohibited_substitutions: A glowing monitoring dashboard replacing the analyst task
One score combining risk, evidence, completeness, and health
A Sidebar and Inspector wrapped around a landing-page interior

ecommerce-operations.label: Ecommerce Operations
ecommerce-operations.summary: Queues and selected records keep money, quantity, channel, ownership, approval, and safe action comparable.
prohibited_substitutions: A KPI card wall replacing an actionable queue
Direction-only red and green treatment
One AI status combining generation, approval, publication, and result

engineering-canvas.label: Engineering Canvas
engineering-canvas.summary: The document or model dominates while tools, structure, selection properties, units, and revision stay precise.
prohibited_substitutions: Workspace cards placed inside the canvas
Decorative grids or nodes with no spatial meaning
Generated changes committed without preview, decision, and undo

shared.command_empty: 没有匹配的页面或规范。
shared.source_boundary_body: 本页根据仓库中的组件与页面目录生成，用于浏览和试用。组件成熟度与实际接入情况仍以对应规范和产品实现为准。

page.title: 组件与交互
page.lead: 先体验常用组件，再按需查看用法、支持情况和实现规范。
page.stable_intro: 按用途分组，快速了解每个组件的用途、状态和适用范围。
page.other_intro: 这些组件仍在整理中，行为和接口可能继续调整。

explorer.reference_intro: 选择状态、主题和视口，在这里体验组件。需要更大空间时，可在新标签页打开。
explorer.reference_language_mismatch: 这项预览尚未提供当前语言版本。
explorer.states_boundary: 此处只展示已经实现的状态。完整状态定义与实现要求见组件规范。
explorer.no_known_gaps: 组件目录中没有记录已知问题。
explorer.accessibility_boundary_body: 这里列出目录中记录的支持情况和自动测试。仍需完成的人工检查会单独显示，不能据此认定读屏软件或实际产品已经通过验收。

button.job: 用清楚的层级和状态完成单次操作，并在处理中、成功或失败时及时反馈。
button.boundary: 预览只演示外观和本地状态；真实请求、权限判断、提交结果和撤销由接入产品实现。

app-shell.job: 在页面切换中保持全局导航、当前工作区、任务信息和命令入口稳定。
app-shell.boundary: 预览只展示应用框架结构；路由、权限、数据和实际接入由产品实现。

evidence-list.job: 把结论与支持它、反驳它或已经过期的来源逐条对应，避免压缩成一个总分。
evidence-list.boundary: 内容为本地样例，不代表实时数据或最终核验结果。

suggested-change-review.job: 让用户在接受、拒绝或编辑前，清楚比较当前值与建议值。
suggested-change-review.boundary: 所有操作只影响本地预览，不会保存业务变更，也不代表用户拥有审批权限。

execution-preview.job: 执行前说明目标、改动、外部影响、所需权限、不可逆项和回退方式。
execution-preview.boundary: 预览不会产生外部影响；授权、范围校验、执行和回退由产品实现。

background-task-queue.job: 让耗时任务在运行、取消、失败、重试和完成后都可追踪。
background-task-queue.boundary: 队列使用本地样例，不代表后端已经支持持久化、幂等、取消或重试。

command-menu.job: 用键盘优先的搜索入口快速跳转页面或执行命令。
command-menu.boundary: 预览使用一组固定命令，只演示打开、筛选、焦点与返回行为，不是产品搜索服务。

authentication-dialog.job: 登录失效或权限不足时，在不丢失当前工作进度的前提下完成身份验证。
authentication-dialog.boundary: 该对话框只演示界面行为，不会验证身份、处理凭据、执行会话策略或授权后续操作。
authentication-dialog.state_label: 已打开的身份验证对话框

data-table.job: 用清楚的列和行语义比较记录，并支持选择、排序与键盘操作。
data-table.boundary: 预览数据量有限；真实数据、虚拟列表、权限、移动端优先级和辅助技术验证由产品负责。

page.title: 按工作方式选择布局
page.lead: 阅读、调查、运营和精确编辑需要不同的布局；界面应随任务变化，而不是套用同一张后台模板。
page.reference_language_mismatch: 这项预览尚未提供当前语言版本。
page.maturity_note: 这里的成熟度来自对应页面记录；布局规范本身不单独评级。

information-site.label: 信息网站
information-site.summary: 搜索、正文、来源和修订信息按阅读顺序出现，便于查找与判断。
prohibited_substitutions: 让营销首屏挡在搜索、主题或正文之前
用一排相同卡片替代记录、引用或阅读顺序
用没有来源的自动摘要替代原始信息

intelligence-workspace.label: 情报工作台
intelligence-workspace.summary: 切换记录时，记录身份、证据、事件和复核进度始终可见。
prohibited_substitutions: 用发光监控大屏替代真实分析任务
用一个分数合并风险、证据、完整度与健康状态
在落地页内部套入侧栏与属性面板

ecommerce-operations.label: 电商运营
ecommerce-operations.summary: 把队列与详情放在一起，便于比较金额、库存、渠道、负责人和审批状态。
prohibited_substitutions: 用 KPI 卡片墙替代可操作队列
只按数值方向使用红色和绿色
用一个 AI 状态合并生成、审批、发布与结果

engineering-canvas.label: 工程画布
engineering-canvas.summary: 以画布为主；工具、结构、所选内容、单位和版本信息围绕当前操作展开。
prohibited_substitutions: 在画布内部放置工作台卡片
使用没有空间含义的装饰网格或节点
在没有预览、决定和撤销时提交生成变更

通用的交互或内容组件。
zh-CN.Structure for dense applications and obj: 用于高密度应用和记录型工作流的结构组件。
zh-CN.Domain component for AI, ecommerce, info: 面向 AI、电商、信息或工程任务的专用组件。
zh-CN.Adopt only when real product requirement: 仅在产品确实需要时采用。
zh-CN.Normative contract, runnable reference,: 已有完整规范、可运行预览和适用的自动测试。
zh-CN.Useful contract or reference exists, but: 已有可用规范或预览，但仍有部分工作尚未完成。
zh-CN.Planned or partially described; consumin: 仍在规划或补充中；接入产品需要记录尚未确定的部分。
zh-CN.Retained only for migration and unavaila: 仅为迁移保留，不允许用于新的实现。
zh-CN.backend authorization, scope drift, side: 后端授权、范围漂移、副作用与回滚
zh-CN.real backend persistence, idempotency, c: 真实后端持久化、幂等、取消与重试
zh-CN.real identity-provider integration: 尚未接入正式登录服务
zh-CN.screen-reader modal behavior and mobile: 屏幕阅读器模态行为与移动端重排
zh-CN.production identity-provider and task-re: 尚未验证正式登录与任务恢复流程
zh-CN.Search, filter, open a record, and ident: 搜索、筛选并打开记录，同时确认来源与时效。
zh-CN.Compare chronology, sources, conflicts,: 记录结论前，对比事件顺序、来源、冲突与不确定性。
zh-CN.Identify a blocking state, affected quan: 识别阻断状态、受影响数量或渠道，以及下一项安全操作。
zh-CN.Select, modify, commit, and undo a struc: 在明确的工作区中选择、修改、提交并撤销结构化内容。
zh-CN.Query, subject, source, revision, and st: 查询、主题、来源、修订与固定链接。
zh-CN.Entity identity with chronology and evid: 记录身份、事件顺序与证据。
zh-CN.Entity, source attribution, verification: 记录、来源出处、核验状态与当前结论。
zh-CN.Actionable exception queue and selected: 可操作的异常队列与已选商品。
zh-CN.Selection, batch scope, currency, quanti: 当前选择、批量操作范围、币种、数量、渠道与负责人。
zh-CN.Canvas with a real selection or active t: 包含真实选择或当前工具的画布。
zh-CN.Tool mode, selection, units, zoom, save: 工具模式、选择、单位、缩放、保存状态与版本。
